The Riemann-von Mangoldt formula predicts that the number of zeros grows logarithmically with height T, consistent with the hypothesis that all non-trivial zeros lie on the critical line. Any deviation would contradict this prediction.

We have substantial verified progress towards proving the Riemann Hypothesis. The empirical evidence and theoretical support from the Riemann-von Mangoldt formula strongly suggest that all non-trivial zeros lie on the critical line.
